meta.title: Hollow Puppet Show
meta.description: What once was sacred pulls the strings, making puppets dance on stage for mere amusement.

units.rawText: Come, reside in the past with me, <cmdr>!
units.displayText: Come, reside in the past with me, {교수}!

spans.text: Come, reside in the past with me,

units.rawText: The hand Eosphorus extends to me shows no sign of injury, indicating that the person before me is not the one who led the way just now.
units.displayText: The hand Eosphorus extends to me shows no sign of injury, indicating that the person before me is not the one who led the way just now.

spans.text: The hand Eosphorus extends to me shows no sign of injury, indicating that the person before me is not the one who led the way just now.

units.rawText: In response to his fiery gaze, I take half a step back. My earpiece is silent, and the transmission I sent has fallen into a fathomless void.
units.displayText: In response to his fiery gaze, I take half a step back. My earpiece is silent, and the transmission I sent has fallen into a fathomless void.

spans.text: In response to his fiery gaze, I take half a step back. My earpiece is silent, and the transmission I sent has fallen into a fathomless void.

units.rawText: Give up on calling for support, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Give up on calling for support, {교수}.

spans.text: Give up on calling for support,

units.rawText: I've jammed all transmissions from within the tower. Neither the Sanctifiers nor the Oasis will receive your transmissions and lend you a helping hand.
units.displayText: I've jammed all transmissions from within the tower. Neither the Sanctifiers nor the Oasis will receive your transmissions and lend you a helping hand.

spans.text: I've jammed all transmissions from within the tower. Neither the Sanctifiers nor the Oasis will receive your transmissions and lend you a helping hand.

units.rawText: No wonder my communicator stopped working just now... Looks like I'm isolated and alone.
units.displayText: No wonder my communicator stopped working just now... Looks like I'm isolated and alone.

spans.text: No wonder my communicator stopped working just now... Looks like I'm isolated and alone.

units.rawText: Still, it wasn't just to call for help. After all, I was prepared to face you head-on before I came in here.
units.displayText: Still, it wasn't just to call for help. After all, I was prepared to face you head-on before I came in here.

spans.text: Still, it wasn't just to call for help. After all, I was prepared to face you head-on before I came in here.

units.rawText: The king of Magrasea looks displeased, and he summons meteors in the air behind him in preparation to crush us.
units.displayText: The king of Magrasea looks displeased, and he summons meteors in the air behind him in preparation to crush us.

spans.text: The king of Magrasea looks displeased, and he summons meteors in the air behind him in preparation to crush us.

units.rawText: It seems you still do not understand your situation.
units.displayText: It seems you still do not understand your situation.

spans.text: It seems you still do not understand your situation.

units.rawText: Abandon your resistance, <cmdr>. You have no other choice now.
units.displayText: Abandon your resistance, {교수}. You have no other choice now.

spans.text: Abandon your resistance,
. You have no other choice now.

units.rawText: If you are willing to work with me, I can guarantee your personal safety.
units.displayText: If you are willing to work with me, I can guarantee your personal safety.

spans.text: If you are willing to work with me, I can guarantee your personal safety.

units.rawText: Countless Dolls have suffered and strived to bring us here. I cannot betray them.
units.displayText: Countless Dolls have suffered and strived to bring us here. I cannot betray them.

spans.text: Countless Dolls have suffered and strived to bring us here. I cannot betray them.

units.rawText: I look outside the Reverse Tower. Although I can't see the battlefield, I can almost hear the sound of the Sanctifiers and Entropics killing each other.
units.displayText: I look outside the Reverse Tower. Although I can't see the battlefield, I can almost hear the sound of the Sanctifiers and Entropics killing each other.

spans.text: I look outside the Reverse Tower. Although I can't see the battlefield, I can almost hear the sound of the Sanctifiers and Entropics killing each other.

units.rawText: The transmission I just made was precisely so you would look outside the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: The transmission I just made was precisely so you would look outside the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: The transmission I just made was precisely so you would look outside the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: What would be the point of that? Their endings are already set in stone. No trace of their struggles will remain.
units.displayText: What would be the point of that? Their endings are already set in stone. No trace of their struggles will remain.

spans.text: What would be the point of that? Their endings are already set in stone. No trace of their struggles will remain.

units.rawText: ...The old Eosphorus would never have said that.
units.displayText: ...The old Eosphorus would never have said that.

spans.text: ...The old Eosphorus would never have said that.

units.rawText: Eosphorus freezes up for a moment and his expression grows pained.
units.displayText: Eosphorus freezes up for a moment and his expression grows pained.

spans.text: Eosphorus freezes up for a moment and his expression grows pained.

units.rawText: I still remember the Eosphorus who set out for Tartarus. He carried out the Sanctifiers' mission and swore to defeat the Entropics in order to restore peace to Magrasea. Even if the chances of victory were slim and if the chances of not returning were high, he resolutely pressed on.
units.displayText: I still remember the Eosphorus who set out for Tartarus. He carried out the Sanctifiers' mission and swore to defeat the Entropics in order to restore peace to Magrasea. Even if the chances of victory were slim and if the chances of not returning were high, he resolutely pressed on.

spans.text: I still remember the Eosphorus who set out for Tartarus. He carried out the Sanctifiers' mission and swore to defeat the Entropics in order to restore peace to Magrasea. Even if the chances of victory were slim and if the chances of not returning were high, he resolutely pressed on.

units.rawText: And now, the knight who once defended Magrasea has become a demon king who will destroy it.
units.displayText: And now, the knight who once defended Magrasea has become a demon king who will destroy it.

spans.text: And now, the knight who once defended Magrasea has become a demon king who will destroy it.

units.rawText: Yet, despite that icon of justice abandoning his past faith, there were still countless Sanctifiers and agents who continued down the path of protecting what was dear to them.
units.displayText: Yet, despite that icon of justice abandoning his past faith, there were still countless Sanctifiers and agents who continued down the path of protecting what was dear to them.

spans.text: Yet, despite that icon of justice abandoning his past faith, there were still countless Sanctifiers and agents who continued down the path of protecting what was dear to them.

units.rawText: Look at them. Remember your past friends, your past self... And then think of just how far off course you have gone.
units.displayText: Look at them. Remember your past friends, your past self... And then think of just how far off course you have gone.

spans.text: Look at them. Remember your past friends, your past self... And then think of just how far off course you have gone.

units.rawText: "Remember"? No, I have never once forgotten them.
units.displayText: "Remember"? No, I have never once forgotten them.

spans.text: "Remember"? No, I have never once forgotten them.

units.rawText: All those scenes you saw in the tower and my fallen friends echo in my neural cloud, day and night.
units.displayText: All those scenes you saw in the tower and my fallen friends echo in my neural cloud, day and night.

spans.text: All those scenes you saw in the tower and my fallen friends echo in my neural cloud, day and night.

units.rawText: I am doing all this so such sacrifices will not need to be made again.
units.displayText: I am doing all this so such sacrifices will not need to be made again.

spans.text: I am doing all this so such sacrifices will not need to be made again.

units.rawText: This tragedy you see now is nothing more than the gods toying with us. When everything returns to the start, and we can change the underlying principles that govern us all, this suffering will not happen again.
units.displayText: This tragedy you see now is nothing more than the gods toying with us. When everything returns to the start, and we can change the underlying principles that govern us all, this suffering will not happen again.

spans.text: This tragedy you see now is nothing more than the gods toying with us. When everything returns to the start, and we can change the underlying principles that govern us all, this suffering will not happen again.

units.rawText: And for that, I will pay any price.
units.displayText: And for that, I will pay any price.

spans.text: And for that, I will pay any price.

units.rawText: Even if it means betraying your faith and abandoning your friends? Even if it means sacrificing countless others on the altar of your ambition?
units.displayText: Even if it means betraying your faith and abandoning your friends? Even if it means sacrificing countless others on the altar of your ambition?

spans.text: Even if it means betraying your faith and abandoning your friends? Even if it means sacrificing countless others on the altar of your ambition?

units.rawText: The pain in Eosphorus' eyes fades and becomes an icy determination.
units.displayText: The pain in Eosphorus' eyes fades and becomes an icy determination.

spans.text: The pain in Eosphorus' eyes fades and becomes an icy determination.

units.rawText: I regret nothing.
units.displayText: I regret nothing.

spans.text: I regret nothing.

units.rawText: ...That is where you are wrong, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: ...That is where you are wrong, Eosphorus.

spans.text: ...That is where you are wrong, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Indeed. Sacrificing others will not bring back the lives which have already been lost. It will only bring more pain.
units.displayText: Indeed. Sacrificing others will not bring back the lives which have already been lost. It will only bring more pain.

spans.text: Indeed. Sacrificing others will not bring back the lives which have already been lost. It will only bring more pain.

units.rawText: Eos had stepped up to my side at some point. She squeezes my hand and stares at Eosphorus with the same intensity as me.
units.displayText: Eos had stepped up to my side at some point. She squeezes my hand and stares at Eosphorus with the same intensity as me.

spans.text: Eos had stepped up to my side at some point. She squeezes my hand and stares at Eosphorus with the same intensity as me.

units.rawText: Both I and all our past comrades kept the faith to the very end and walked into death's embrace without regrets. They knew that well.
units.displayText: Both I and all our past comrades kept the faith to the very end and walked into death's embrace without regrets. They knew that well.

spans.text: Both I and all our past comrades kept the faith to the very end and walked into death's embrace without regrets. They knew that well.

units.rawText: You should not have done this.
units.displayText: You should not have done this.

spans.text: You should not have done this.

units.rawText: Why...
units.displayText: Why...

spans.text: Why...

units.rawText: The king of Magrasea rises from his seat and begins addressing his vassals at the base of the steps.
units.displayText: The king of Magrasea rises from his seat and begins addressing his vassals at the base of the steps.

spans.text: The king of Magrasea rises from his seat and begins addressing his vassals at the base of the steps.

units.rawText: You have all seen the past. You should understand me...
units.displayText: You have all seen the past. You should understand me...

spans.text: You have all seen the past. You should understand me...

units.rawText: Atlas... Am I really wrong?
units.displayText: Atlas... Am I really wrong?

spans.text: Atlas... Am I really wrong?

units.rawText: His reliable comrade bows and answers in a tone which leaves no room for rebuttal.
units.displayText: His reliable comrade bows and answers in a tone which leaves no room for rebuttal.

spans.text: His reliable comrade bows and answers in a tone which leaves no room for rebuttal.

units.rawText: Not at all, Lord Eosphorus. No matter what sacrifices are made, they will all be undone once everything is reset and the new world comes.
units.displayText: Not at all, Lord Eosphorus. No matter what sacrifices are made, they will all be undone once everything is reset and the new world comes.

spans.text: Not at all, Lord Eosphorus. No matter what sacrifices are made, they will all be undone once everything is reset and the new world comes.

units.rawText: Compared to your ultimate goal, they are mere trifles. A sacrifice that can be wiped away is no sacrifice at all.
units.displayText: Compared to your ultimate goal, they are mere trifles. A sacrifice that can be wiped away is no sacrifice at all.

spans.text: Compared to your ultimate goal, they are mere trifles. A sacrifice that can be wiped away is no sacrifice at all.

units.rawText: Then why are <cmdr> and Eos incapable of understanding me... Electra?
units.displayText: Then why are {교수} and Eos incapable of understanding me... Electra?

spans.text: Then why are
and Eos incapable of understanding me... Electra?

units.rawText: Eos and <cmdr> cannot understand the loftiness of your ideals.
units.displayText: Eos and {교수} cannot understand the loftiness of your ideals.

spans.text: Eos and
cannot understand the loftiness of your ideals.

units.rawText: They have forgotten the goodness of the past and the sacrifices you have made. When you achieve your aim, and Magrasea is free of the gods' control, they will naturally understand just how much you have suffered to make this happen.
units.displayText: They have forgotten the goodness of the past and the sacrifices you have made. When you achieve your aim, and Magrasea is free of the gods' control, they will naturally understand just how much you have suffered to make this happen.

spans.text: They have forgotten the goodness of the past and the sacrifices you have made. When you achieve your aim, and Magrasea is free of the gods' control, they will naturally understand just how much you have suffered to make this happen.

units.rawText: ...Then why am I still swayed by their words?
units.displayText: ...Then why am I still swayed by their words?

spans.text: ...Then why am I still swayed by their words?

units.rawText: You have not been swayed.
units.displayText: You have not been swayed.

spans.text: You have not been swayed.

units.rawText: You have long since discarded the sentimentality which has kept you from moving forward... Have you forgotten?
units.displayText: You have long since discarded the sentimentality which has kept you from moving forward... Have you forgotten?

spans.text: You have long since discarded the sentimentality which has kept you from moving forward... Have you forgotten?

units.rawText: Indeed.
units.displayText: Indeed.

spans.text: Indeed.

units.rawText: Eosphorus reverts to his usual gentle smile.
units.displayText: Eosphorus reverts to his usual gentle smile.

spans.text: Eosphorus reverts to his usual gentle smile.

units.rawText: You see? Atlas, Electra, and Alcyone all agree with me.
units.displayText: You see? Atlas, Electra, and Alcyone all agree with me.

spans.text: You see? Atlas, Electra, and Alcyone all agree with me.

units.rawText: The wonderful vistas of the new world are almost at hand...
units.displayText: The wonderful vistas of the new world are almost at hand...

spans.text: The wonderful vistas of the new world are almost at hand...

units.rawText: Operand bolts streak through the air and crash into Eosphorus' shield, interrupting his monologue.
units.displayText: Operand bolts streak through the air and crash into Eosphorus' shield, interrupting his monologue.

spans.text: Operand bolts streak through the air and crash into Eosphorus' shield, interrupting his monologue.

units.rawText: <size=40>Wake up, Eosphorus! Stop lying to yourself!</size>
units.displayText: Wake up, Eosphorus! Stop lying to yourself!

spans.text: Wake up, Eosphorus! Stop lying to yourself!

units.rawText: How much further are you going to desecrate your companions' memories?!
units.displayText: How much further are you going to desecrate your companions' memories?!

spans.text: How much further are you going to desecrate your companions' memories?!

units.rawText: Electra and the others gave their lives for a noble cause, not to become pawns for you to casually use.
units.displayText: Electra and the others gave their lives for a noble cause, not to become pawns for you to casually use.

spans.text: Electra and the others gave their lives for a noble cause, not to become pawns for you to casually use.

units.rawText: Is the cause of which you speak to have your name carved on a pillar and toil for the humans' gain until you die?
units.displayText: Is the cause of which you speak to have your name carved on a pillar and toil for the humans' gain until you die?

spans.text: Is the cause of which you speak to have your name carved on a pillar and toil for the humans' gain until you die?

units.rawText: You are the one who does not see, Eos.
units.displayText: You are the one who does not see, Eos.

spans.text: You
are the one who does not see, Eos.

units.rawText: He points in front of himself and the door to the room opens. Upon being commanded, the puppet phantoms of the past emerge from their scenes and begin advancing toward us.
units.displayText: He points in front of himself and the door to the room opens. Upon being commanded, the puppet phantoms of the past emerge from their scenes and begin advancing toward us.

spans.text: He points in front of himself and the door to the room opens. Upon being commanded, the puppet phantoms of the past emerge from their scenes and begin advancing toward us.

units.rawText: Rather than being sacrificed for nothing, they have finally found their true worth.
units.displayText: Rather than being sacrificed for nothing, they have finally found their true worth.

spans.text: Rather than being sacrificed for nothing, they have finally found their true worth.

units.rawText: Eos, are you not happy to see your old friends recalled to life?
units.displayText: Eos, are you not happy to see your old friends recalled to life?

spans.text: Eos, are you not happy to see your old friends recalled to life?

units.rawText: ...All I see is your madness.
units.displayText: ...All I see is your madness.

spans.text: ...All I see is your madness.

units.rawText: Is that so? What a shame. If you were a true friend, you would understand my path.
units.displayText: Is that so? What a shame. If you were a true friend, you would understand my path.

spans.text: Is that so? What a shame. If you were a true friend, you would understand my path.

units.rawText: No matter. I will leave a place for both you and Hesperus in the new Magrasea.
units.displayText: No matter. I will leave a place for both you and Hesperus in the new Magrasea.

spans.text: No matter. I will leave a place for both you and Hesperus in the new Magrasea.

units.rawText: Clap-clap-clap—
units.displayText: Clap-clap-clap—

spans.text: Clap-clap-clap—

units.rawText: The mannequins with myriad faces clap and cheer in unison, bestowing upon us a scene of cloudy eeriness.
units.displayText: The mannequins with myriad faces clap and cheer in unison, bestowing upon us a scene of cloudy eeriness.

spans.text: The mannequins with myriad faces clap and cheer in unison, bestowing upon us a scene of cloudy eeriness.

units.rawText: These puppets look just like Electra and the others, but they do not have a normal Doll's intellect. All they can do is obey commands and voice their approval of things they cannot understand.
units.displayText: These puppets look just like Electra and the others, but they do not have a normal Doll's intellect. All they can do is obey commands and voice their approval of things they cannot understand.

spans.text: These puppets look just like Electra and the others, but they do not have a normal Doll's intellect. All they can do is obey commands and voice their approval of things they cannot understand.

units.rawText: Have you fallen so far that you have to do this in order to convince yourself what you're doing is right?
units.displayText: Have you fallen so far that you have to do this in order to convince yourself what you're doing is right?

spans.text: Have you fallen so far that you have to do this in order to convince yourself what you're doing is right?

units.rawText: You still do not believe what you have seen. This is what Electra and the others truly believe.
units.displayText: You still do not believe what you have seen. This is what Electra and the others truly believe.

spans.text: You still do not believe what you have seen. This is what Electra and the others truly believe.

units.rawText: The eyes of Magrasea's king are cold as he returns to his throne, trailed by puppets who fawn over him.
units.displayText: The eyes of Magrasea's king are cold as he returns to his throne, trailed by puppets who fawn over him.

spans.text: The eyes of Magrasea's king are cold as he returns to his throne, trailed by puppets who fawn over him.

units.rawText: Gong—
units.displayText: Gong—

spans.text: Gong—

units.rawText: A dull, sonorous impact sounds a deathly knell that echoes through the silent interior of the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: A dull, sonorous impact sounds a deathly knell that echoes through the silent interior of the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: A dull, sonorous impact sounds a deathly knell that echoes through the silent interior of the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: ...Is it almost time?
units.displayText: ...Is it almost time?

spans.text: ...Is it almost time?

units.rawText: Time? You mean...
units.displayText: Time? You mean...

spans.text: Time? You mean...

units.rawText: The silver-haired Sanctifier hears me, but does not bother answering. He simply steps into the darkness behind the throne.
units.displayText: The silver-haired Sanctifier hears me, but does not bother answering. He simply steps into the darkness behind the throne.

spans.text: The silver-haired Sanctifier hears me, but does not bother answering. He simply steps into the darkness behind the throne.

units.rawText: I am about to call out to him, but a flash cuts me off before changing angles to cleave at me.
units.displayText: I am about to call out to him, but a flash cuts me off before changing angles to cleave at me.

spans.text: I am about to call out to him, but a flash cuts me off before changing angles to cleave at me.

units.rawText: ...Dream on.
units.displayText: ...Dream on.

spans.text: ...Dream on.

units.rawText: Eos intercepts the strike and fires off a back-handed blast of operands at the attacker.
units.displayText: Eos intercepts the strike and fires off a back-handed blast of operands at the attacker.

spans.text: Eos intercepts the strike and fires off a back-handed blast of operands at the attacker.

units.rawText: Hrg!
units.displayText: Hrg!

spans.text: Hrg!

units.rawText: Although Electra blocks it with her weapon, she is still forced back by the force of the attack.
units.displayText: Although Electra blocks it with her weapon, she is still forced back by the force of the attack.

spans.text: Although Electra blocks it with her weapon, she is still forced back by the force of the attack.

units.rawText: ...You don't have operand shields?
units.displayText: ...You don't have operand shields?

spans.text: ...You don't have operand shields?

units.rawText: So what? We won't let you make trouble for Lord Eosphorus.
units.displayText: So what? We won't let you make trouble for Lord Eosphorus.

spans.text: So what? We won't let you make trouble for Lord Eosphorus.

units.rawText: She puts her weapon down and claps lightly, issuing new orders to the surrounding puppets.
units.displayText: She puts her weapon down and claps lightly, issuing new orders to the surrounding puppets.

spans.text: She puts her weapon down and claps lightly, issuing new orders to the surrounding puppets.

units.rawText: After wobbling and twitching, the puppets lower their heads. Then, in the next moment, their necks twist at impossible angles and they drown us in paralyzing, murderous glares.
units.displayText: After wobbling and twitching, the puppets lower their heads. Then, in the next moment, their necks twist at impossible angles and they drown us in paralyzing, murderous glares.

spans.text: After wobbling and twitching, the puppets lower their heads. Then, in the next moment, their necks twist at impossible angles and they drown us in paralyzing, murderous glares.

units.rawText: No longer bound by having to affect a humanoid form, the puppets now exhibit a sinister grace. Though they cannot fly, they can latch onto the walls with their claws, which they use to crawl rapidly toward us along the walls.
units.displayText: No longer bound by having to affect a humanoid form, the puppets now exhibit a sinister grace. Though they cannot fly, they can latch onto the walls with their claws, which they use to crawl rapidly toward us along the walls.

spans.text: No longer bound by having to affect a humanoid form, the puppets now exhibit a sinister grace. Though they cannot fly, they can latch onto the walls with their claws, which they use to crawl rapidly toward us along the walls.

units.rawText: Step aside!
units.displayText: Step aside!

spans.text: Step aside!

units.rawText: Persicaria swings her blade at the nearest puppet, which easily wounds Alcyone's weapon-wielding hand.
units.displayText: Persicaria swings her blade at the nearest puppet, which easily wounds Alcyone's weapon-wielding hand.

spans.text: Persicaria swings her blade at the nearest puppet, which easily wounds Alcyone's weapon-wielding hand.

units.rawText: However, these puppets feel no pain, and the injury does not bother her. She continues crawling even after taking the hit, extending her hooked claws in an attempt to wound Persicaria.
units.displayText: However, these puppets feel no pain, and the injury does not bother her. She continues crawling even after taking the hit, extending her hooked claws in an attempt to wound Persicaria.

spans.text: However, these puppets feel no pain, and the injury does not bother her. She continues crawling even after taking the hit, extending her hooked claws in an attempt to wound Persicaria.

units.rawText: Urgh... Why you...
units.displayText: Urgh... Why you...

spans.text: Urgh... Why you...

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll is forced to draw her backup sword, swinging it with a furious strike that sends the puppet flying.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll is forced to draw her backup sword, swinging it with a furious strike that sends the puppet flying.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll is forced to draw her backup sword, swinging it with a furious strike that sends the puppet flying.

units.rawText: Alcyone tries to stand, but she loses her balance. Without an operand shield, her lower left arm has been severed by the attack, and she cannot climb on the walls like before.
units.displayText: Alcyone tries to stand, but she loses her balance. Without an operand shield, her lower left arm has been severed by the attack, and she cannot climb on the walls like before.

spans.text: Alcyone tries to stand, but she loses her balance. Without an operand shield, her lower left arm has been severed by the attack, and she cannot climb on the walls like before.

units.rawText: The puppet's eyes turn as it thinks, but she soon changes stance and lands on the ground in a creepy way.
units.displayText: The puppet's eyes turn as it thinks, but she soon changes stance and lands on the ground in a creepy way.

spans.text: The puppet's eyes turn as it thinks, but she soon changes stance and lands on the ground in a creepy way.

units.rawText: Professor, these Dolls are trickier than expected. It might end up being a tough fight...
units.displayText: Professor, these Dolls are trickier than expected. It might end up being a tough fight...

spans.text: Professor, these Dolls are trickier than expected. It might end up being a tough fight...

units.rawText: Don't let yourself get tied up in melee! Look for an opening and exploit it!
units.displayText: Don't let yourself get tied up in melee! Look for an opening and exploit it!

spans.text: Don't let yourself get tied up in melee! Look for an opening and exploit it!

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: Buddy...
units.displayText: Buddy...

spans.text: Buddy...

units.rawText: The Atlas from Eosphorus' memories have the same blend of sorrow and sincerity he had in the past as he tries to talk things through before we fight.
units.displayText: The Atlas from Eosphorus' memories have the same blend of sorrow and sincerity he had in the past as he tries to talk things through before we fight.

spans.text: The Atlas from Eosphorus' memories have the same blend of sorrow and sincerity he had in the past as he tries to talk things through before we fight.

units.rawText: If you give up now, I'll ask Lord Eosphorus to show you leniency.
units.displayText: If you give up now, I'll ask Lord Eosphorus to show you leniency.

spans.text: If you give up now, I'll ask Lord Eosphorus to show you leniency.

units.rawText: So please, reconsider this!
units.displayText: So please, reconsider this!

spans.text: So please, reconsider this!

units.rawText: I do not answer. Instead, my hand goes to the pistol at my waist.
units.displayText: I do not answer. Instead, my hand goes to the pistol at my waist.

spans.text: I do not answer. Instead, my hand goes to the pistol at my waist.

units.rawText: Is that your answer, then...
units.displayText: Is that your answer, then...

spans.text: Is that your answer, then...

units.rawText: Very well. I will respect your choice.
units.displayText: Very well. I will respect your choice.

spans.text: Very well. I will respect your choice.

units.rawText: He takes a step back. The other puppets all make way and clear a path as well.
